method: Opened each venue's own website (one to four pages) as a reader would; dead domains confirmed with Google and Cloudflare DNS-over-HTTPS; JS-rendered prices read with Firecrawl. No maps, social, directory or review sources used as evidence.
selection: 40 catalogue venues with tier corroborated, a phone and their own (non-social) website; all eligible venues outside Nairobi except one whose 'website' is a YouTube link, plus 14 in Nairobi.
secondPass: Every evidence URL of the 10 verified venues was re-fetched fresh and each quote searched verbatim: 71 of 74 found in the page HTML; the 3 remaining (Tumaini day/monthly price, InShape monthly price) render only in the browser and were re-confirmed with a fresh Firecrawl render. smartgyms.co.ke intermittently serves a bot-check page to plain fetches; a retry and the Firecrawl render both showed the quoted text. Fields dropped on review: InShape sauna (FAQ says yes, homepage says spa 'coming soon'), Mnarani classes (undated 'starting September'), all Dojo prices (no currency in the table), all Level 24 prices ('Rates on request').
